versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the square-post skill for posting pure text content to Binance Square.
- Supports authentication via X-Square-OpenAPI-Key with secure display of credentials.
- Auto-prompts users for missing API key or post content.
- Polishes user input and provides an option to use optimized or original text before posting.
- Returns a direct post URL upon successful posting.
- Comprehensive error handling and messaging based on API response codes.
